Outcome is diabetic retinopathy. Covariates include age (years), sex, race categorized as non-hispanic white, non-hispanic black, mexican american, other hispanic, and other race, education categorized as primary school, secondary, school, college or above, or not recorded, poverty income ratio (PIR), categorized as Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, and Q_unknown (for missing values). Participants did not know or were not told by doctors whether they had diabetes were excluded. Participants who were on the borderline of diabetes were excluded. Missing or refused to answer the diabetes question will be excluded. Participants who were not told by doctors whether they had diabetic retinopathy were excluded. Participants with missing serum albumin ALB (g/dL) or serum creatinine SCR (mg/dL) or urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio UACR (mg/g) will be excluded. Participants who were less than 20 years old were excluded.

-- STEP 2.1: Exclude participants who did not know or were not told by doctors whether they had diabetes, or if the answer was missing/refused.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step1 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" NOT IN ('Borderline');

-- STEP 2.2: Exclude participants who were on the borderline of diabetes (i.e., ever told they had prediabetes = 'Yes').
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step2 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."ever_told_you_have_prediabetes" IS NULL
   OR f."ever_told_you_have_prediabetes" = 'No';

-- STEP 2.3: Exclude participants who were not told by doctors whether they had diabetic retinopathy (i.e., missing).
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step3 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step2 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."diabetes_affected_eyes_had_retinopathy" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.4: Exclude participants with missing serum albumin ALB (g/dL).
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step4 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step3 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."albumin_g_dl" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.5: Exclude participants with missing serum creatinine SCR (mg/dL).
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step5 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step4 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."creatinine_mg_dl" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.6: Exclude participants with missing urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio UACR (mg/g).
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step6 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step5 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."albumin_creatinine_ratio_mg_g" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.7: Exclude participants who were less than 20 years old.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step7 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step6 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."age_in_years_at_screening" >= 20;

-- ========== STEP 3: Cohort ==========

-- The final temp table in the exclusion sequence becomes temp_cohort.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_cohort AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step7;

-- ========== STEP 4: Variables ==========

-- 4.1 Age (years)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_age_years AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."age_in_years_at_screening" AS "age_years"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.2 Sex
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_sex AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."gender" AS "sex"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.3 Race
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_race AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       CASE
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Non-Hispanic White' THEN 'non-hispanic white'
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Non-Hispanic Black' THEN 'non-hispanic black'
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Mexican American' THEN 'mexican american'
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Other Hispanic' THEN 'other hispanic'
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Other Race - Including Multi-Racial' THEN 'other race'
           ELSE NULL
       END AS "race"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.4 Education
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_education AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       CASE
           WHEN f."education_level_children_youth_6_19" IN ('Less Than 5th Grade', 'Less than 5th grade', '1st Grade', '1st grade', '2nd Grade', '2nd grade', '3rd Grade', '3rd grade', '4th Grade', '4th grade') THEN 'primary school'
           WHEN f."education_level_children_youth_6_19" IN ('5th Grade', '5th grade', '6th Grade', '6th grade', '7th Grade', '7th grade', '8th Grade', '8th grade', '9th Grade', '9th grade', '10th Grade', '10th grade', '11th Grade', '11th grade', '12th Grade, No Diploma', '12th grade, no diploma', 'GED or Equivalent', 'GED or equivalent', 'High School Graduate', 'High school graduate', 'Less Than 9th Grade', 'Less than 9th grade') THEN 'secondary school'
           WHEN f."education_level_children_youth_6_19" = 'More than high school' THEN 'college or above'
           WHEN f."education_level_children_youth_6_19" IN ('Never Attended / Kindergarten Only', 'Never attended / kindergarten only') THEN 'not recorded'
           ELSE 'not recorded'
       END AS "education"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.5 Poverty Income Ratio (PIR)
-- Extract raw PIR values for cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_pir_raw AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."ratio_of_family_income_to_poverty" AS "pir_value"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Compute quartile cutoffs for PIR within cohort, excluding NULLs for cutoff calculation
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_pir_cutoffs AS
SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "pir_value") AS q1,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "pir_value") AS q2,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "pir_value") AS q3
FROM temp_pir_raw
WHERE "pir_value" IS NOT NULL;

-- Assign PIR quartile group, with 'q_unknown' for missing values
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_poverty_income_ratio_pir AS
SELECT p."respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN p."pir_value" IS NULL THEN 'q_unknown'
    WHEN p."pir_value" <= (SELECT q1 FROM temp_pir_cutoffs) THEN 'q1'
    WHEN p."pir_value" <= (SELECT q2 FROM temp_pir_cutoffs) THEN 'q2'
    WHEN p."pir_value" <= (SELECT q3 FROM temp_pir_cutoffs) THEN 'q3'
    ELSE 'q4'
  END AS "poverty_income_ratio_pir"
FROM temp_pir_raw p;

-- 4.6 UACR-SACR Ratio (Predictor)
-- Calculate raw UACR-SACR ratio
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_uacr_sacr_ratio_raw AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       (f."albumin_creatinine_ratio_mg_g" / (f."albumin_g_dl" / f."creatinine_mg_dl")) AS "uacr_sacr_ratio_value"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."albumin_g_dl" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."creatinine_mg_dl" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."creatinine_mg_dl" != 0;

-- Compute quartile cutoffs for UACR-SACR ratio within cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_uacr_sacr_ratio_cutoffs AS
SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "uacr_sacr_ratio_value") AS q1,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "uacr_sacr_ratio_value") AS q2,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "uacr_sacr_ratio_value") AS q3
FROM temp_uacr_sacr_ratio_raw
WHERE "uacr_sacr_ratio_value" IS NOT NULL;

-- Assign UACR-SACR ratio quartile group
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_uacr_sacr_ratio AS
SELECT u."respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN u."uacr_sacr_ratio_value" IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN u."uacr_sacr_ratio_value" <= (SELECT q1 FROM temp_uacr_sacr_ratio_cutoffs) THEN 'Q1: <=25%'
    WHEN u."uacr_sacr_ratio_value" <= (SELECT q2 FROM temp_uacr_sacr_ratio_cutoffs) THEN 'Q2: >25% and <=50%'
    WHEN u."uacr_sacr_ratio_value" <= (SELECT q3 FROM temp_uacr_sacr_ratio_cutoffs) THEN 'Q3: >50% and <=75%'
    ELSE 'Q4: >75%'
  END AS "uacr_sacr_ratio"
FROM temp_uacr_sacr_ratio_raw u;

-- 4.7 Diabetic Retinopathy (Outcome)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_diabetic_retinopathy AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       CASE
           WHEN f."diabetes_affected_eyes_had_retinopathy" = 'Yes' THEN '1'
           WHEN f."diabetes_affected_eyes_had_retinopathy" = 'No' THEN '0'
           ELSE NULL
       END AS "diabetic_retinopathy"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- ========== STEP 5: Final Table ==========
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_final_table AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  age."age_years",
  sex."sex",
  race."race",
  edu."education",
  pir."poverty_income_ratio_pir",
  uacr."uacr_sacr_ratio",
  dr."diabetic_retinopathy"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN temp_age_years age ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = age."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_sex sex ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = sex."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_race race ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = race."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_education edu ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = edu."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_poverty_income_ratio_pir pir ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = pir."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_uacr_sacr_ratio uacr ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = uacr."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_diabetic_retinopathy dr ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = dr."respondent_sequence_number";
